description: Generate wallet trust fact profiles for up to 10 wallets in a single request. Shared block fetches make this 5-8x faster than sequential calls. Each wallet gets an independently ECDSA-signed profile with its own TRST-XXXXX ID. Supports partial success — failed wallets get error entries while successful ones return full profiles. Costs 3 credits per successful wallet (standard) or 6 credits per wallet (proof: 'merkle'). Credits only charged for successful profiles.

proof.description: Set to 'merkle' for EIP-1186 Merkle storage proofs on all wallets (6 credits/wallet).

bitcoinWallet.description: Bitcoin address. Adds Bitcoin Holdings dimension.

solanaWallet.description: Solana wallet address (base58). Adds USDC on Solana and institutional EURCV/USDCV on Solana checks.

stellarWallet.description: Stellar wallet address (G-prefixed). Adds institutional USDC and BENJI on Stellar checks.

suiWallet.description: Sui wallet address (0x + 64 hex). Adds institutional USDC on Sui check.

tronWallet.description: Tron wallet address (T-prefixed). Adds USDT-TRC20 on Tron check.

xrplWallet.description: XRPL wallet address (r-address). Adds RLUSD, USDC, and institutional EURCV on XRPL checks.

name: insumer_batch_wallet_trust
